tytul: How to Prepare for a Therapy Session (So You Stop Wasting the First 15 Minutes)
tresc_html:
You sit down, your therapist asks how the week went, and your mind goes blank. The thing that wrecked you on Tuesday is suddenly unreachable. Ten minutes of warm-up later, you finally land on what matters, and now there are thirty minutes left. Here is how to walk in ready instead.

Why the first minutes evaporate

Memory research has a name for this: retrieval failure under context change. What felt urgent at home does not automatically surface in a different room, on a different day, in front of another person.

What actually helps

Capture things when they happen, not the night before. A two-line note on Tuesday beats an hour of reconstruction on Friday.

[FEATURE: session-prep | MindSync builds a prep card from your week automatically, so the topics walk in with you.]

Frequently asked questions

What should I talk about in therapy?

Whatever kept showing up during the week. If you tracked it, you already have the list.

Should I write notes before a therapy session?

Yes, but capture them during the week instead of writing an essay the night before.
